name: stargaze
description: Point your phone at the sky and it tells you what you are looking at. GPS, clock and compass -- no image recognition.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && cap run ios
